environment: guc-performance-test / PostgreSQL 17.6 / real GoTrue / Edge Runtime / PostgREST

results.details: Employee cannot read another employee or unpublished draft ratings; limited own draft progress is separate.
Unassigned supervisor denied read and creation through Gateway.
Four roles, seven distinct criteria each; 100% required and invalid template rejected.
All four roles compute 80.00/B from all-4 ratings; persisted RPC result agrees.
Unassigned training accepts reasoned N/A; assigned-but-unperformed cannot claim unassigned N/A.
25/20 active weights rescale to persisted 88.89.
60%×78 + 40%×86 persists as 81.20/B with unrounded role intermediates.
90% allocation rejected atomically; previous 100% allocation and score preserved.
All N/A or any positive-allocation NO_DATA role makes whole month null and blocks submission.
Forged score, employee scoring, and admin self-approval assignment rejected.
Actual worker is an evidence candidate; a reporter absent from worker links is not.
Shared assignment is candidate-only and does not grant per-person points.
Nonproject task created, completed, independently verified; project count unchanged.
Published source snapshot/score immutable; explicit second revision keeps previous current version.
Ratings, reply, approval, publication record actor/time/before/after/request; no session tokens.
Eight simultaneous tasks and six reviews create one row per request; changed payload conflicts.
Stale row_version returns HTTP 409 without overwriting the latest saved score.
No attendance/work-count inputs enter calculation; forged leave-days rejected without score change.
Private source, frozen summary and source identifiers hidden after permission revocation, including supervisor.
Export uses same server-side per-review scope; employee export contains no peer data or notes.
L1–L4 validates evidence and assessor, keeps versions, and denies employee self-edit.
Quarter uses two valid published samples (84.45), reports 50%/month and missing month; NO_DATA excluded.
Direct anon/authenticated denial, fractional rating rejection, rounding/grade boundaries, workday deadline and disabled-session denial.
